articles.title: Covia Announces Laura Riquelme as Chief Financial Officer
articles.mainIdea: Covia Announces Laura Riquelme as Chief Financial Officer
articles.summary: Business Wire: Covia Announces Laura Riquelme as Chief Financial Officer. INDEPENDENCE, Ohio, April 01, 2026--Covia, a leading provider of mineral-based and material solutions for the Industrial markets, today announced that Laura Riquelme has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective April 6, 2026.

articles.title: Avantor® Announces CFO Transition
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Avantor® Announces CFO Transition. Avantor, Inc. (NYSE: AVTR), a leading global provider of mission-critical products and services to customers in the life sciences and advanced technology industries, today announced that Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (CFO), R. Brent Jones, will leave the Company on or before June 24, 2026. Related tickers mentioned: AVTR.
